description: Argus于1951年推出的旁轴相机。配备Argus Cintar f/2.8 coated anastigmat, Series IV (20.6mm) filters。快门速度1/10, 1/25, 1/50, 1/100, 1/300, Bulb (early version only went to 1/200)。使用135 (35mm)。coincident image type coupled rangefinder。

specs.闪光灯: Hot shoe; sync selector switch (early: M & F, later: M & X)
specs.镜头: Argus Cintar f/2.8 coated anastigmat, Series IV (20.6mm) filters
specs.英文简介: The Argus C4 is a 35mm fixed lens rangefinder camera manufactured by Argus Cameras, Inc.
